title: will 与 be going to

examples.en: Look at the dark clouds. It's going to rain.
Don't worry. I will help you.

guess.question: 两句都说将来的事，为什么一句用 be going to，一句用 will？

options.text: 第一句眼前有迹象（乌云），第二句是说话时才做的决定
options.feedback: 对！有没有迹象、是不是临时决定，是两者的分水岭。

options.text: 第一句更正式，第二句更口语
options.feedback: 不对——正式程度不是判据，两者口语里都用。
不对——多数情况可以换，但“眼前有迹象”时只能用 be going to。

left.label: will + 动词原形
left.formula: will + 原形（否定 won't + 原形）

anchor.en: Don't worry. I will help you.

left.focus: 说话当下才做的决定，或单纯预测将来

right.label: be going to + 动词原形

anchor.en: Look at the clouds. It's going to rain.

right.focus: 事先已经打算好，或眼前有迹象表明要发生

contrast.diff: 事先有计划、眼前有迹象 → be going to；说话时才决定、单纯预测 → will。多数句子两者都能用，但“有迹象”这一条只能用 be going to。

traps.wrong: Look at the sky! It will snow.
traps.right: Look at the sky! It's going to snow.
traps.why: 眼前有迹象（天色、乌云）时，必须用 be going to。

traps.wrong: The phone is ringing. I'm going to answer it.
traps.right: The phone is ringing. I'll answer it.
traps.why: 电话响了才临时决定去接，属于临时决定，用 will 更自然。

guess_callback: 你刚才选的是 A——记住一句话：有迹象、早打算用 be going to；临时决定用 will。

check.stem: Look at the dark clouds. It ____ rain soon.

options.distractor: 眼前有迹象时要用 be going to
现代英语里 shall 极少用于陈述句

check.explanation: 乌云是眼前迹象，用 is going to rain。

check.stem: — The phone is ringing. — I ____ answer it.

options.distractor: 这是临时决定，不是事先计划
will 后面直接接动词原形

check.explanation: 听到铃声才决定去接，是临时决定，用 will。

options.text: I will to go there tomorrow.
options.distractor: will 后面直接接原形 go

options.text: I going to go there tomorrow.
I am going go there tomorrow.
I am going to go there tomorrow.

check.explanation: be going to 的完整结构是 am/is/are going to + 动词原形。
